paragraph: I think an online **mob** is after me. The angry **mob** started throwing rocks at us. I was being chased by an angry **mob**.
english: a large angry crowd; a criminal gang

paragraph: A **plea** bargain is out of the question. The prosecution offered a **plea** deal. You should consider a **plea** bargain.
english: a strong request; a statement in court

paragraph: He claims that he is a **painter**. That's the **painter** whose picture you want to buy. This **painter** is well known in the art world.
english: an artist who paints pictures

other.meaning: laborer who paints surfaces using a paintbrush

paragraph: Some people say **tolerance** is a two-way street. To some people, **tolerance** is another word for weakness. Our government has zero **tolerance** policy against corruption.
english: the ability or practice of tolerating

paragraph: Newspaper will soak up the **pee**. Did you **pee** yourself again? He **peed** up the window.
english: urine

paragraph: Overseas **subsidiaries** are putting out top-of the-line products.
english: a company owned by a bigger company

paragraph: Please take your shoes off before crossing the **threshold**. He has never crossed the **threshold** of my house. I finally crossed the **threshold** of that house.
english: the lowermost part of a doorway that one crosses to enter

other.meaning: outset of an action or project

paragraph: Nobody can roof a house with a single **tile**. A broken roof **tile** fell next to us. The builder is installing **tile** on the wall.
english: a rectangular graphic

paragraph: The box is from **Chile**, according to the label. **Chile** stretches down the west coast of South America. Tonight I will travel for business to **Chile**.
english: a country in South America. Official name: Republic of Chile. Capital and largest city: Santiago

paragraph: What color are you going to **dye** your hair? I'm going to have to **dye** my hair. My boyfriend wants to **dye** his hair purple.
english: a colorant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied

other.meaning: To colour with dye, or as if with dye (verb)

paragraph: We could see the **sunset** from the window. I've never seen such a beautiful **sunset**. How many pictures of the **sunset** can I take?
english: time of day
arabicDesc: مثال: أمكننا أن نرى غروب الشمس من النافذة.

other.meaning: changes in color of sky at sunset

paragraph: Outside the **mansion** were trees with golden autumn leaves. That's easy for you to say from your **mansion**. Thank you for allowing us into your beautiful **mansion**.
english: a large luxurious house or building, usually built for the wealthy

paragraph: They watched her gradually **weaken** as the disease progressed. The foundation of this house is beginning to **weaken**. The storm will **weaken** during the course of the day.
english: to make or become weaker

paragraph: Nothing happens unless it is **preceded** by a dream. In Asia men usually **precede** women when walking. The flash of lightning **precedes** the sound of thunder.
english: to go before, go in front of
arabicDesc: مثال: لا شيء يحدث إن لم يكن حلما في البداية.

paragraph: My **nephew** is coming over tomorrow. Because my **nephew** was still young, he was forgiven. He's the son of my sister. He's my **nephew**.
english: fraternal or sororal nephew — see also fraternal nephew, sororal nephew
arabicDesc: مثال: سيأتي ابن أخي عندي غدا.

paragraph: They went on an **expedition** to the North Pole. We encountered a lot of difficulties on the **expedition**. He will be going on a bird watching **expedition**.
english: an organized journey for a purpose

paragraph: The rear tire of my **bicycle** is flat. If you win, I'll give you my **bicycle**. Why don't you ride your **bicycle** to work?
english: any similar vehicle powered by human pedaling or steered with a handlebar, regardless of the number of wheels

paragraph: In this story, the hero is also the **villain**. Afterwards, he set off for **Villain** Valley. She is a comic book **villain**.
english: a vile, wicked person

paragraph: The **vendor** weighs the cheese with copper scales. The street **vendor** sold hot dogs and soda. I bought that from a street **vendor**.
english: a person or a company that vends or sells

paragraph: The **clerk** didn't take much trouble over the work. You'll have to speak to the **clerk** about that. I couldn't find a **clerk** to wait on me.
english: one who occupationally provides assistance by working with records, accounts, letters, etc

paragraph: I really can't understand modern **sculpture**. The city holds an ice **sculpture** festival each year. This **sculpture** is more than two thousand years old.
english: art of sculpting
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا حقا لا أستطيع أن أفهم فن النحت الحديث.

other.meaning: work of art created by sculpting

paragraph: Children are quick to gain **orientation** to new circumstances. Your sexual **orientation** is not something you can change. We will have a period of **orientation** for freshmen.
english: direction; also an introduction to a new place

paragraph: The trees were **slim**, growing close to one another. If you want to be **slim**, follow this diet. I'm not as **slim** as my older sister.
english: slender

paragraph: I want a **massage**. I need to relax. She gave him a foot **massage**. Monday was a busy day at the **massage** clinic.
english: rubbing, kneading, or hitting muscled part of a body
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد التدليك. أحتاج إلى الاسترخاء.

other.meaning: To rub and knead (someone's body or body part), to perform a massage on (somebody) (verb)

paragraph: Why does your daughter **dislike** candies? I **dislike** seeing her picture. He is such a bad person that everybody **dislikes** him.
english: not to like something

paragraph: They caught wind of the **merger** before it was announced. Company attorneys are working around the clock to complete the **merger**. The **merger** was implemented on a 50-50 ratio.
english: the act or process of merging two or more parts into a single unit

paragraph: You used to be a physical **therapist**, didn't you? I had a speech **therapist** when I was younger. My **therapist** always gets hard when he sees me.
english: a person trained to treat physical or mental problems

paragraph: We don't need another disease **outbreak** in the village. Do they want to cause a new **outbreak** of violence? The city was devastated by the **outbreak**.
english: an eruption

paragraph: This is the **dictionary** I told you about yesterday. Do you know how to use a **dictionary**? Whose **dictionary** is it on the table?
english: reference work of words and their meanings
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا هو القاموس الذي حدثتك عنه البارحة.

paragraph: We had a rough crossing on an old **ferry**. At most, there were only 100 passengers on the **ferry**. I took the **ferry** because I went by car.
english: a boat or ship used to transport people, smaller vehicles and goods from one port to another, usually on a regular schedule

paragraph: You should read books **beneficial** to you. This is a **beneficial** work. Fruit, milk and sports are very **beneficial** to health.
english: helpful or good to something or someone
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي أن تقرأ كتبا مفيدة لك.

paragraph: The **butler** brought me my coffee into the library. I asked the **butler** to serve us some coffee. The **butler** announced the arrival of the royal guests.
english: a manservant having charge of wines and liquors

paragraph: I'll have a large **Coke** and a large fry. Give me a liter of **Coke** and three glasses. More than one bottle of **coke** was consumed.
english: cola-based soft drink

paragraph: As you know, life is **comparable** to a voyage. This metal is **comparable** to iron in strength. What's **comparable** to beautiful knowledge? Nothing!
english: similar

paragraph: Up to then there had been no official announcement or **confirmation**. I made a reservation online but I didn't receive a **confirmation** email. Many relatives came to the **confirmation**.
english: an official indicator that things will happen as planned

paragraph: Don't forget that families have their own internal **dynamics**. The **dynamics** on this sheet music are all wrong. Science can help us understand the **dynamics** of complex systems.
english: the branch of mechanics that is concerned with the effects of forces on the motion of objects

paragraph: The laboratory acquired a **fabulous** reputation for its historic discovery. They have a **fabulous** view of the creek. We spent a **fabulous** day in the woods.
english: extremely good

paragraph: You should treat your toys **gently** and with care. Take the trash bag out **gently** to prevent ripping. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss **gently**.
english: in a soft, calm way

paragraph: In some attempts, it is **glorious** even to fail. It's a **glorious** day. Too good to stay inside. You should set forth the **glorious**, revolutionary tradition.
english: very beautiful or impressive; deserving honor

paragraph: He's the only one who understands my **grief**. It's a **grief** that is digging into my soul. **Grief** is one of the worst forms of suffering.
english: suffering, hardship
arabicDesc: مثال: هو الوحيد الذي يفهم سبب حزني.

paragraph: **Historically**, now is a good time to buy. Fork-users have **historically** been in the minority. Many authors ignore the existence of this **historically** important person.
english: in the past

paragraph: It is **inevitable** that some changes will take place. A loss of trust on both sides was **inevitable**. Death is common to all and **inevitable** for man.
english: impossible to avoid or prevent

other.meaning: The fifty-sixth sura (chapter) of the Qur'an (noun)

paragraph: I didn't steal it. I just borrowed it **permanently**. It is not easy to stop smoking **permanently**. The top of the mountain is **permanently** covered with snow.
english: forever

paragraph: Almost all **provincial** and district governors are on our side. He lives in a small, **provincial** town. I live in a **provincial** town.
english: relating to a province

paragraph: This question must be discussed **separately** from that one. In a mosque, men and women pray **separately**. Let's not weaken our endeavor by working **separately**.
english: not together

paragraph: There is a **subtle** difference between the two words. There are **subtle** differences between the two things. I will pay him back later in a **subtle** way.
english: not obvious

paragraph: The way his life was cut short is **tragic**. The **tragic** news drove his mother mad. I was moved to tears by the **tragic** story.
english: causing great sadness

paragraph: Yes, that was amazing. **Unbelievable**! It is **unbelievable** that he did something like that. The speed with which we forget is just **unbelievable**.
english: incredible
arabicDesc: مثال: نعم، كان ذلك مذهلاً ، لا يُصدق.

paragraph: The bridge had to be high to allow boats to pass **underneath**. There are lots of presents **underneath** the Christmas tree. The piece of glass **underneath** my skin was painful.
english: below; in a place beneath
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يجب أن يكون الجسر عاليا كي تتمكّن السّفن من المرور تحته.

other.meaning: on the underside or lower face of

paragraph: The video that you uploaded yesterday has gone **viral**. China can't get its **viral** situation under control. A video posted on social media of the singing went **viral**.
english: caused by a virus; spreading quickly online

paragraph: The sisters are both **blondes**. A girl with **blonde** hair came to see you. Who is the **blonde** girl with the red skirt?
english: having pale yellow hair

paragraph: The researchers use the **portal** to enter into a different part of the universe. This **portal** was created exclusively for students to use. He has been looking for this **portal** for decades.
english: a website that leads to other sites; a large door
arabicDesc: مثال: يستخدم الباحثون البوابة للدخول لأجزاء مختلفة من العالم.

paragraph: He was a **freshman** and she was a senior. He transferred to that school in his **freshman** year. Even a **freshman** can do that.
english: a student in the first year of high school or college

paragraph: There has been an attack at the **subway** station. When was the last time you took the **subway**? I can't stand dirty old men in the **subway**.
english: an underground railway, especially for mass transit of people in urban areas

paragraph: Let him **bark** like a dog. Why do dogs **bark** at night? Maybe we are just **barking** up the wrong tree.
english: to make a loud noise (dogs)

other.meaning: The short, loud, explosive sound uttered by a dog, a fox, and some other animals (noun)
The exterior covering of the trunk and branches of a tree or of various other woody plants (noun)

paragraph: In all **probability**, the money will not be paid. There is a high **probability** that we won't survive. She felt a hint of guilt at this **probability**.
english: how likely something is

paragraph: Death is the exit from a **simulation** into Reality. The show is only a **simulation** of reality. The proposed method is applied to three case studies in **simulation**.
english: something that simulates a system or environment in order to predict actual behaviour

paragraph: Cut your coat according to your **cloth**. Always use a clean **cloth** to wipe the console. You and I, we're cut from the same **cloth**!
english: specifically, a tablecloth, especially as spread before a meal or removed afterwards
arabicDesc: مثال: على قدر لحافك مد رجليك، رحم الله إمرءاً عرف قدر نفسه.

other.meaning: piece of cloth for a particular purpose

paragraph: When was the last time you used a **ruler**? A **ruler** helps one to draw a straight line. There was once a cruel **ruler** in the country.
english: a (usually rigid), flat, rectangular measuring or drawing device with graduations in units of measurement

paragraph: He has made a fine **comeback** on the stage. She's always quick on the **comeback** to any criticism. Since their **comeback** three years ago, how have they been doing?
english: a return (e.g. to popularity, success, etc.) after an extended period of obscurity or underperformance

paragraph: Remember to brush before going to school, **champ**. I've won my way into University. Now it's time to study like a **champ**. I'm **champing** at the bit like a wild horse.
english: a champion (informal)

paragraph: She was a member of the Red Army **Faction**. The two **factions** gang up with each other. The two **factions** joined forces.
english: strife

paragraph: My father is a **banker**. I'm a financial analyst. There is nothing of the **banker** in his bearing. I want to be a **banker** when I grow up.
english: one who conducts the business of banking

paragraph: The early bird gets the **worm**. I don't think I could ever eat a **worm**. The **worm** is being eaten by a bird.
english: a generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum

paragraph: Could you identify him in a **lineup**? That team has a strong **lineup**.
english: a physical or photographic queue of people allegedly involved in a crime, allowing a witness to identify them

paragraph: Letters of **sympathy** kept flooding in. You often find that **sympathy** gives place to love. He has no **sympathy** for single parent families.
english: feeling of pity or sorrow for the suffering or distress of another — see also compassion
arabicDesc: مثال: واصلت رسائل التّعاطف في الوصول بأعداد كبيرة.

paragraph: He managed to **dodge** the arrow just in time. I was somehow able to **dodge** the attack with ease. The dog is lying in the shade of the **Dodge**.
english: to move quickly to avoid something

paragraph: We must do everything we can to **stimulate** the economy. We aim to **stimulate** the creation of a private space industry. We provide activities that **stimulate** them.
english: to encourage activity or growth

paragraph: There will be a big **disclosure**. **Disclosure** is the act or result of communicating something secret or hidden to other people.
english: making information known

paragraph: Watch you don't trip on that **tin** of paint. Is it all right if I open a **tin**? Do you know the difference between silver and **tin**?
english: a malleable, ductile, metallic element, resistant to corrosion, with atomic number 50 and symbol Sn

paragraph: Suddenly smelling smoke could be a sign of **stoke**. We want our cold nights in **Stoke**. The performer relied on hype and headlines to **stoke** up interest in her music.
english: to add fuel to a fire; to increase a feeling

paragraph: They communicate with each other by **gesture**. She gave me a hand **gesture** I didn't understand. He made a **gesture** to me to run away.
english: a motion of the limbs or body, especially one made to emphasize speech
arabicDesc: مثال: هم يتواصلون مع بعضهم البعض بالإيماءات.

paragraph: My choices reflect my ambition to **thrive** in life. I don't just want to survive, but to **thrive**. We seek not just to survive, but to **thrive**.
english: to grow or increase stature

paragraph: Since when has the gas **gauge** stopped working? When did the fuel **gauge** stop working? Keep an eye on the fuel **gauge**.
english: a device that measures; to judge

paragraph: I don't particularly like the taste of diet **soda**. Are you sure you don't want another **soda**? You can't swap baking powder for baking **soda**.
english: sodium bicarbonate

paragraph: The paint is put on with a **roller**. Which do you enjoy more, ice skating or **roller** skating? Can we **roller**-skate in this park?
english: a round object that rolls

paragraph: I know you are hiding yourself behind the **curtain**. The **curtain** has not yet risen. There was a **curtain** which was covering the door.
english: a piece of cloth covering a window, bed, etc. to offer privacy and keep out light
arabicDesc: مثال: أعلم أنك مختبئ خلف الستار.

paragraph: The **automobile** runs on electricity. We are producing spare parts in an **automobile** factory. The city is most famous for its **automobile** industry.
english: a car

paragraph: He didn't worship the **idols**. The rock star is an **idol** of the teenagers. I have always seen you as an **idol**.
english: a graven image or representation of anything that is revered, or believed to convey spiritual power
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن يعبد تلك الأصنام.

paragraph: The teacher tripped over the **cord**. Is the power **cord** plugged into a power outlet? I need a new extension **cord** like this one.
english: a long, thin, flexible length of twisted yarns (strands) of fibre (a rope, for example)

paragraph: His words and **deeds** do not match. To what extent can you answer for his **deed**? There is a huge gap between word and **deed**.
english: an action or act

other.meaning: brave or noteworthy action, feat or exploit

paragraph: The path is **steep** and rocky at the beginning. I found the banana on a **steep** mountain road. The way up the hill was very **steep**.
english: rising or falling sharply

paragraph: Her **ego** is a bit too big for teaching. Failing the exam was a blow to his **ego**. They have too much **ego** and they lack honesty.
english: the self, especially with a sense of self-importance

paragraph: I'm not a **nationalist**, I'm a patriot. The situation changed after the fall of the **nationalists**.
english: of or relating to nationalism

paragraph: A **defect** was found in the water-cooling circuit. There must be a **defect** in the experimental method. This eye **defect** can be corrected by surgery.
english: a fault or malfunction

paragraph: I didn't see you at my **cocktail** party last weekend. Do you want to drink a perfect **cocktail**? That **cocktail** is sweet and easy to drink.
english: alcoholic beverage
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لم أركَ في حفلة الكوكتيل الإسبوع الماضي.

paragraph: Make a **virtue** of necessity. Glory follows **virtue** as if it were its shadow. Some say the beauty is more important than **virtue**.
english: accordance with moral principles

paragraph: I recognized her at first **glance**. They hurried by without a **glance**. It was easier than it seemed at first **glance**.
english: a quick look
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد عرفتها من الوهلة الأولى.

paragraph: She is the only **trustee** of the university who never attended it as a student. Tom served as a **trustee** for three years.
english: a person who manages property or money for others

paragraph: The plan was **altogether** spoiled by the rain. The house was **altogether** destroyed by the fire. Another universe is perhaps a different reality **altogether**...
english: completely; in total

paragraph: I don't think it's **ethical** for you to do that. This investment fund only invests in **ethical** companies. I think it might not be **ethical** to do that.
english: of or relating to the study of ethics

paragraph: He won the prize for **excellence** in all subjects. I aim for **excellence** in all areas of my life. He strives for **excellence** in every task.
english: being excellent

paragraph: You live **freely** if you haven't a reputation to lose. Are we allowed to let our dogs run **freely**? Now that Father is gone, we can talk **freely**.
english: without limits
arabicDesc: مثال: تعيش حرا إن لم يكن عندك سمعة تخسرها.

paragraph: The student council discussed plans for the **graduation**. I didn't wear a suit to my **graduation** ceremony. I didn't walk in my high school **graduation** ceremony.
english: the action or process of graduating
arabicDesc: مثال: إدارة الطلّلاب ناقشت حول التّخرج.

paragraph: I see that I am surrounded by **hostile** faces. Some people took **hostile** attitudes toward the illegal aliens. The police tried to separate the two **hostile** gangs.
english: not friendly

paragraph: He had to lead a **miserable** life for many years. You just made my life **miserable**. He lives a **miserable** life.
english: in a state of misery
arabicDesc: مثال: اضطر للعيش فقيرا لسنوات عدة.

paragraph: As the days passed, our campaign grew in **momentum**. He wants to build on this **momentum**. How do you keep the **momentum** going?
english: of a body in motion: the tendency of a body to maintain its inertial motion

other.meaning: impetus, either of a body in motion, or of an idea or course of events

paragraph: The shooting and subsequent trial attracted **nationwide** attention. The police have started a **nationwide** hunt for the criminal. Museums, theaters and cinemas have been closed **nationwide**.
english: across the whole country

paragraph: You should write as **nicely** as you always do. A bottle of cold mineral water would do **nicely** now. This painting is **nicely** done. It looks just like Mom.
english: in a nice or good way

paragraph: Two to the **ninth** power is five hundred twelve. I was born on the twenty-**ninth** of February. I have just received your letter of the **ninth**.
english: the ordinal form of the number nine

other.meaning: The person or thing in the ninth position (noun)
